workflow_plan.goal: Calculate average elevation inside the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundaries to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the State College and Bellefonte polygon boundaries into the DEM CRS so zonal statistics can use compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input GeoPackage vector layer from its observed CRS to EPSG:3857. Preserve the borough features and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the average DEM elevation within the State College and Bellefonte borough polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate zonal statistics for the raster in input_1 using the reprojected borough polygons. Produce a CSV summary with the mean elevation for each borough, retaining available identifying attributes such as NAME.

requirements.scope: The source CRS for input_2 must be present before reprojection.
Both the DEM and the reprojected borough boundaries must have explicit CRS metadata before zonal statistics.
The DEM and borough boundary geometries must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The borough polygons used as zonal boundaries must have valid, non-empty geometries.
The DEM must spatially cover the State College and Bellefonte borough polygons sufficiently to calculate statistics for both zones.
The zonal statistics worker must receive the DEM as GeoTIFF and the polygon zones as GeoPackage.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.
